title: An injective morphism that is an open immersion on the members of an open covering of the source is an open immersion
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] whose map of underlying sets is injective. Assume that every point $x\in X$ lies in the image of some open immersion $i:U\to X$ [def-weil-open-immersion] such that the composite $f\circ i:U\to Y$ is an open immersion. Then $f$ is an open immersion; in particular $f$ is a homeomorphism of $X$ onto the open subset $f(X)$ of $Y$.
